name: GPT-Realtime-2.1
summary: GPT-Realtime-2.1 is OpenAI's speech-to-speech reasoning model for the Realtime API, released in July 2026 as an update to GPT-Realtime-2. OpenAI says it improves alphanumeric recognition, silence and noise handling, and interruption behavior, and it supports configurable reasoning effort and tool calling for voice agents. It takes text, audio and image input and answers in text or audio.
goodFor: Tool calls during a live call
Capturing spoken codes, names and numbers
watchOut: Audio input costs 8x text input per token
Higher reasoning effort adds latency and output tokens
Realtime endpoint only; no structured outputs
